# bitbucket_workspace (Data Source)

Looks up the Bitbucket Cloud workspace the provider is configured for.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_workspace" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier (the workspace slug).
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the workspace is private.
- `name` (String) Workspace display name.
- `slug` (String) Workspace slug.
- `uuid` (String) Bitbucket-assigned UUID of the workspace.
